name: @payswap/zcode-bridge
description: ZCode substrate bridge (Work Order P3-W3): typed, versioned, framework-free contracts that expose the pinned ZCode platform substrate — tool registry, tool declarations, model-facing tool wire, MCP server/tool contracts and naming, skills, session events and session/runtime IDs, subagents, model/provider selection, the dynamic-workflow engine vocabulary, its runtime NDJSON protocol, and the RPC transport wire — to PaySwap as TYPED OBSERVATIONS ONLY. The bridge is platform-adjacent (MODULE-OWNERSHIP: treat as platform; may_depend_on [contracts, platform]) and holds ZERO financial authority (no_parallel_financial_authority): no obligation/clearing/settlement/reservation/finality semantics, no proxying of financial calls — substrate capabilities surface as descriptive contracts, never as authorization. Zero runtime dependencies; TypeScript + Vitest dev tooling only; no node: imports in src.
